items.title: Hasbro (HAS) Partners To Develop Playocity In Jeddah
items.summary: Hasbro (NasdaqGS:HAS) has partnered with BAAN Holding Group to create Playocity, a large family entertainment destination in Jeddah. The Playocity project will be located at Westfield Center in Jeddah, expanding Hasbro branded attractions into Saudi Arabia. Management plans to feature Hasbro characters and entertainment brands within Playocity to build out a broader family-focused venue.
